listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aqua Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Eternity Aqua captures the essence of today's modern man - expressing himself and his relationships in a way that is truly reflective of his life.He approaches life and love with an easy confidence - combined with an effortless elegance and an unforced charm, making it all look so simple.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aqua Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Eternity Aqua captures the essence of today's modern man - expressing himself and his relationships in a way that is truly reflective of his life.He approaches life and love with an easy confidence - combined with an effortless elegance and an unforced charm, making it all look so simple.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Night Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A dark and mysterious fragrance from Calvin Klein. Released in 2014, Eternity Night for men opens with coriander seed, plum and a sprinkling of paprika. A floral heart using notes of clary sage, violet and lavender gives the fragrance an aromatic core. Finally the scent weaves together sandalwood, cedar and vetiver for a solid woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2015, this floral fragrance begins with top notes of litchi, quince, and sorbet; heart notes of peony, peach blossom, and neroli; and base notes of cashmere wood, ambroxan, and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Euphoria for women is an oriental fragrance that contrasts exotic fruits, seductive florals and a rich, creamy signature. Containing top notes of pomegranate, succulent persimmon and a lush green accord; middle notes of black orchid, dewy lotus blossom and champaca flower and base notes of liquid amber, black violet, sensual musks, mahogany wood and a cream accord.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria For Him Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Travel Set
listings.description: The Euphoria Men fragrance from Calvin Klein was launched in the year of 2006, this scent is addictive fresh and oriental with an intriguing freshness and modern sensuality. Top notes of ginger pepper cocktail, raindrop accord and chilled sudachi. An aromatic heart of black basil, cedar leaf and hydroponic sage. A sensual drydown of creamy suede, addictive patchouli, brazilian redwood and solid amber.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: <p class="p1">Obsession is one of the best perfumes ever launched. There is little wonder why so many of us have this exciting scent in our arsenal of fragrances. It is hard to believe it was first released in 1985. Thanks to its blend of tones of oriental spices, Calvin Klein Obsession remains as contemporary today as it did back then. It would be fair to say that it is a must-have perfume.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1">Although packed with exciting tones, the scent is subtle enough for daytime wear. However, it is during the evening or night the perfume comes into its own. As it drifts through the cooler night air, you will instantly recognise it.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1">The 100ml bottle looks smooth and cool, and will never look out of place on any dressing table or in a bathroom cabinet. Obsession Perfume is the gift or personal fragrance choice that keeps on giving. No one will be disappointed by a gift of the fragrance. Needless to say, it also makes a fantastic perfume treat for yourself if it does not already sit on your dressing table.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p>

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men is the pure essence of masculinity. Potent, powerful, and intensely provocative, this scent is a compelling blend of botanicals, spices, and rare woods. Designed in 1986, Obsession cologne for men is a refreshing, oriental, woody fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession Night Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A fragrance for the young, sophisticated, approachable, vivacious woman, Obsession Night was created for the risk-taker who is unafraid of experimentation. This delicious fruity blend of citrus, fresh flowers, sexy vanilla, and elegant amber captures the warmth and intensity of the night and the woman who shines.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YS2VDCR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty is an ageless classic. The sexy, warm, floral essence has led to the popularity of this scent. The opening notes of this fragrance are an airy veil of sweet flowers combined with delicious berries, fresh peaches, and crisp bergamot. The middle notes include sweet peony, subtle lily, and sensual jasmine. The base consists of deep woodsy sandalwood, earthy musk, and rich vanilla blossom.   The sweet floral-fruity bouquet mixed with the richness of vanilla makes it a great fragrance for everyday wear. The warm sexy ora of citrusy bergamot, rich jasmine, and sandalwood make it a perfect Eau de Toilette for evening wear. The addition of musk leads to the longevity of the smell so that you have to reapply less often. The combination of all of these luscious scents makes Sheer Beauty Calvin Klein 100ml an excellent choice for every occasion.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: <p>Azzaro Wanted is looking for you, the sophisticated man ready to take on the world. It wants you, the charismatic Don Juan, who lives life on the edge. Celebrate life with this powerful bottle of seduction and strength. Let the Wanted aftershave arouse that which you crave.</p> <p>This bold fragrance gets driven by spicy, citrus, and woody notes, radiating a desire for the man who wears it. The Wanted man oozes confidence and independence as he instinctively pursues his passions and wins. Dare to be invincible with Azzaro Wanted 100ml.</p> <p>Even the bottle drips with masculine sex appeal with its metallic contours that scream your name. Its unique shape begs for you to rip its cap off and basque in its aromatic luxury.</p>

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Introducing Azzaro 'Wanted' an audacious and flamboyant new fragrance for men. It is a woody, citrus and spicy eau de toilette with a fresh, sensual and captivating masculinity. A fragrance of vibrant and explosive brings freshness, unfolding into a bold spicy accord revealing a radiant and spirited personality. Its sensual woody notes establish a new elegant and captivating masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Azzaro pour Homme by Azzaro is a aromatic fougere fragrance for men. Azzaro pour Homme was launched in 1978. The noses behind this fragrance are Gerard Anthony, Martin Heiddenreich and Richard Wirtz. Top notes are caraway, orris, lavender, clary sage, basil, anise, bergamot and lemon; middle notes are sandalwood, juniper berries, patchouli, vetiver, cedar and cardamom; base notes are leather, tonka bean, amber, musk and oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Azzaro pour Homme by Azzaro is a aromatic fougere fragrance for men. Azzaro pour Homme was launched in 1978. The noses behind this fragrance are Gerard Anthony, Martin Heiddenreich and Richard Wirtz. Top notes are caraway, orris, lavender, clary sage, basil, anise, bergamot and lemon; middle notes are sandalwood, juniper berries, patchouli, vetiver, cedar and cardamom; base notes are leather, tonka bean, amber, musk and oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Club Women Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: An oriental fragrance opening with top notes of pomegranate and passion fruit; middle note of cashmere wood; and base notes of vanilla and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Club Men Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: A woody aromatic fragrance that opens with top notes of lemon and papaya; middle note of cannabis; and base notes of hinoki and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2007 Chrome Legend is a follow-up to 1996's Chrome, and is described as 'a more sophisticated fragrance'.The notes include tea, green apple, bitter orange, musk, moss, sea spray, cedar, vetiver, amber and tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Azzaro Chrome Intense opens with a citrusy union of bergamot and grapefruit, creating sparkling chords embellished with tart ginger and hedione molecule. The heart develops notes of ozone, jasmine water and lichen, while the base is created of precious wood, mate, amber and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Built on a dominant citrus and musk accord, the fragrance arouses freshness and vigor. A gentle aquatic note is added to this opening aroma, followed by a woody end note mixed with shades of 'tea'. Top note: Lemon, Petitgrain, Rosemary, Pineapple. Middle note : Coriander, Jasmine, Cyclamen, Orris. Base note : Cedarwood, Moss, Tonka, Musk. The packaging is adorned in Mediterranean steel-blue, a symbol of purity, and a silver metal color for refinement and perfection. It is made of transparent glass, with a chevron top in the shape of a horsewoman.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VAV10CF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Introducing Azzaro Chrome the new Eau de Toilette for men. Chrome is a citrus, aquatic and woody fragrance that reveals a luminous, vibrant and comforting freshness thanks to its aquatic notes. Azzaro Chrome features fresh notes of bergamot, grapefruit and ginger, aquatic notes of transparent musks and comforting notes of amber, sandalwood and maté leaves to create a blend of intense and enveloping freshness.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Florabotanica Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Inspired by a strange and wonderful garden in which you do not know whether the flowers are innocent or poisonous, Florabotanica from Balenciaga evokes the 18th Century botanical gardens in which the most exotic and rarest plant species were displayed. Strange-coloured plants discovered in distant countries brought back from their travels by enthusiastic biologists.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga B Balenciaga Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Fresh and alluring, the fragrance opens with green notes of edamame and lily of the valley bell. As B.BALENCIAGA evolves, the iris note reveals a powdery essence before drying down with darker woody notes of cashmeran woods.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Paris Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Balenciaga Paris is a lovely paradox. It is a perfume that becomes life, that melds with living. Wear Balenciaga Paris and become a close yet inaccessible woman who strolls under leafy arbors. Balenciaga Paris opens with demure notes of violet make this a light, floral and pleasing scent. Balenciaga Paris then moves into peppery notes that reveal themselves and evoke a scent of calm, mossy wood. Balenciaga Paris is a fragrance full of light with a few dark apertures that create a complex and intoxicating allure.

listings.rawTitle: Beyonce Heat Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Beyoncé Heat Fragrance Collection Catch the fever with Beyoncé Heat, the first fragrance by Beyoncé. Sensual. Sexy. Sophisticated. Beyoncé Heat is an alluring, feminine fragrance featuring rare sensual flowers created for the modern woman exuding confidence, sexiness and energy. Let yourself feel the heat.

listings.rawTitle: Anna Sui Flight of Fancy Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: This scent brings the explosion of luminous Java lemon, litchi, and yuzu notes, followed with soft notes of Star Magnolia, rose blossom, and waves of Purple Rain Freesia. The bottom notes end the composition with amber crystals, light wood, and skin musk, bringing peace and tranquillity.

listings.rawTitle: Anna Sui Secret Wish Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Secret Wish expresses Anna Suir's own magical optimism -- wishing will make it so. All things are possible; one has only to ask. Only to reveal a hidden, innermost wish. And, from somewhere beneath a blue bell, a new fragrance spirit emerges.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Havana Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created in 1994 by Aramis, Havana Aftershave is a sexy, masculine fragrance with a rich scent of rum and tobacco. This is a truely seductive and intoxicating cologne, suitable for romantic use.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Adventurer Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: Offering a daring foray into woody aromatic fragrances, Adventurer by Aramis provides a lively scent that perfectly compliments the courageous and hardy man who tackles the world head-on, daring to experience a challenging and exciting world. A sharp, zesty accord of lemon, bergamot and black pepper tops the fragrance with a kick. A core of bitter wormwood, lavender and geranium gives the heart a deep aromatic vibe and, finally, a base of patchouli, cedar and seawood provides a grounding, savoury finish.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Voyager Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: An aromatic spicy fragrance for men, opening with top notes of ginger, juniper berries, and black pepper; heart notes of nutmeg, sage, and lavender; and a base of tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Aramis Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Aramis in 1965 this self-titled fragrance, Aramis is a refined masculine scent that possesses a blend of rich spices, sandalwood, leather, moss and clove. It is recommended for evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Aramis Eau de Toilette 240ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Aramis in 1965 this self-titled fragrance, Aramis is a refined masculine scent that possesses a blend of rich spices, sandalwood, leather, moss and clove. It is recommended for evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Blossom Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Euphoria Blossom by Calvin Klein is a sparkling, citrus, casual fragrance for the modern woman. It has top notes of kumquat, dewy green accord pomegrante, a heart of orchid blossom, lotus blossum pink peony petals woods, amber musk at the base.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity is an exciting revolution in the modern world of perfume. Like a soft melody, Eternity for women plays with the fragrance notes and creates a memorable perfume composition. The fragrance tones are quite feminine in style, with the floral scent prominent in the chic bottle of Eternity Calvin Klein. The sophisticated yet timelessly elegant and simple scent is what we love about the Calvin Klein brand. Eternity for women steps even higher by delivering a mixture of a bouquet of beautiful flowers and the spicy nuances of golden amber and sandalwood. Opening the bottle is like the exhilaration and anticipation that a woman feels when she finds her true love. The intertwining notes of lilies, white roses, violets, and the gentle essences of spicy notes dance like two soulmates that were destined to be together. Let the music of Calvin Klein Eternity take over and sweep you off your feet with the deep emotions of passion and love hidden in this prestige perfume scent.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Shock For Him Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WUEM3VB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} CK One Shock was created by noted perfumers Ann Gottlieb, Loc Dong and IFF.  This eau de toilette presents as a masculine and alluring aromatic that includes ingredients clementine and purple lavender on top,  a middle of cardamon and osmanthus, and a bottom of patchouli, musk, chocolate, and tobacco.   When first applied a fresh slightly citrusy aroma may be noted, perhaps with a hint of rose as well, soon to be enriched with tobacco, musk, and chocolate undertones. The complete effect is a woodsy appealing scent that is hard to resist.   Calvin Klein, the leading global lifestyle company, has long been a leader in the perfume/cologne market, having achieved great success with its CK One Unisex release in 1994. 2011's follow-up, One Shock for Him 200ml, reaffirmed One Shock's position with men, featuring a new carefully blended fragrance representative of CK's modern and authentic style.   One Shock for Him, created for you.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Euphoria a fragrance from Calvin Klein, has top notes of pomegranate, persimmon and lush green accord within the heart imparts a mysterious and intoxicating feeling through notes of rich black orchid, dewy lotus blossom and sensual champaca flower. The drydown provides a lasting signature of liquid amber, black violet, cream accord and mahogany wood.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Secret Obsession Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Secret Obsession explores the secrets that lie between love and madness. It's about being taunted with illicit thoughts and compelled with seeking pleasure.An oriental floral composed of exotic plum, nutmeg, rose de damask, Egyptian jasmine, orange blossom, tuberose, cashmere woods, vanilla, burnt amber and Australian sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Moment Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A fresh squeezed floral bursting with succulent beauty. The Eternity Moment fragrance blooms with the lush sensuality of dew-kissed, fresh florals.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Free Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: CK Free by Calvin Klein. This is a aromatic and woody fragrance for men. It contains of star anise, jackfruit, absinthe, juniper berry, suede, tobacco leaves, coffee absolute, South African buchu, patchouli absolute, oak wood, cedar wood and Costa Rican ironwood.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK Be Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: CK Be by Calvin Klein. This is a fresh, floral, aromatic and woody fragrance for both men and women. It contains of bergamot, mandarin, juniper, lavender, peppermint, green notes, jasmine, orchid, freesia, magnolia, peach, cedar, amber, musk, sandal and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=V029VGI]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein Obsession for Men Eau de Parfum captures the pure essence of masculinity. Potent, powerful, and provocative, it's a compelling, intense blend of botanics, spices, and rare woods. Potent and sensual, Calvin Klein Obsession for Men is an eau de parfum that awakens inner strength. Composed of a compelling blend of botanics, spices, and rare woods, it embodies the pure essence of masculinity. Driven by passion, Obsession for Men exudes the determination and fire powerful men are made of. Notorious, unforgettable, and provocative, it's a sexy interpretation of limitless potential. Leading with bergamot and mandarin, the fragrance opens up on a light and fresh note before developing into a complex blend of myrrh, sage, and lavender. A warm, woody base of musk, sandalwood, and vetiver completes the powerful scent.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK IN2U Him Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: Fresh but warm; a tension that creates sexiness.Spontaneous - sexy - connectedCK IN2U him is a fresh woody oriental that penetrates with lime gin fizz and rushes into a combination of cool musks that radiate from top to bottom and leaves you wanting more.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Red Edition for Him Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Taking the original CK One fragrance and injecting a stylish new edge to its iconic spirit, CK One Red for Him features notes of juicy red pear, ginger, heated black pepper and tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Truth Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Truth is a refreshing, oriental, woody fragrance. This scent contains a fresh natural blend of rich woods that react to individual skin chemistry. It is recommended as a daytime fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Deep Euphoria Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: This fragrance from Calvin Klein was released in 2016 and although it is part of the Euphoria range, it is described as being a separate fragrance and brings a completely new composition with it. Its top notes are white pepper, mandarin leaf and cascalone, middle notes of jasmine sambac, geranium, peony and black rose and ends with patchouli, musk and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Endless Euphoria Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: This fragrance opens up with a light breeze of cherry blossom, refreshed with mandarin and bergamot. Pastel rose and violet form the day-dream inspired heart of the perfume, and it's followed by its gentle and sensual base of bamboo, sandalwood and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Escape For Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Calvin Klein in 1993, Escape is a refreshing, spicy, lavender, amber fragrance. This masculine scent contains a blend of apple, plum, peach, bergamot, juniper, rosemary and is accented with sage, mandarin and sandalwood making ESCAPE perfect for everyday use.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aqua Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Eternity Aqua for Women is described as a modern fragrance that wraps you with its casual elegance, charm and a touch of mystery. Its character is fresh aquatic, as the name suggests, enriched with woody accords and notes of light flowers.It opens with an explosive mix of Pink Lady apple, cucumber, apricot and white peony. Modern bouquet of white flowers is at the heart of the perfume, including jasmine, tiare, gardenia and magnolia. Sensual sun-drenched woods, cedar and transparent musk are located in the base.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK All Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: A refreshing citrus fragrance, first launched in early 2017. The scent features top notes of: mandarin, bergamot and grapefruit blossom; middle notes of jasmine, lily, rhubarb and freesia; and base notes of musk, vetiver and warm amber.
